# v2.32-dev Release Notes

## Training Data — clearer "leads to certification" wording

This refines the certification indicator added in v2.31. An ILT or OLX is the
**recommended preparation** you take before sitting the exam that earns a
certification — it does **not** itself grant the cert. The v2.31 presentation (a
green "Cert" badge on the row) could read as "this training *is* a cert," so it
has been re-worded and re-placed.

### Changed

- **List (Admin → Training Data)** — the green **Cert** badge is gone. Instead,
  a **"→ Leads to: …"** subline now appears under the Full Title, naming the
  certification(s) the ILT/OLX prepares you for (styled like the existing
  "→ Replaced by" legacy subline).
- **Full Title detail page** — the **Certification** column is gone. Instead, a
  **Leads to Certification(s)** card sits in the summary row (next to
  Function(s)), listing the deduplicated certifications drawn from **all** mapped
  training titles.
- **Wording** — when editing or adding an ILT/OLX, the certification picker is
  now labelled **"Leads to Certification(s)"** (previously "Certifications
  granted" / "Certification").

### Notes

- No database changes, no configuration changes. Nothing to do after updating.
